sentences.en: The skilled craftsman restored the shattered vase piece by piece.
sentences.zh: 这位技艺高超的手工艺人逐块修复了破碎的花瓶。

sentences.en: This pleasant vision was shattered by a most unpleasant interruption.
sentences.zh: 这美好的景象被最不愉快的打断给打破了。

sentences.en: A solemn wisp of smoke rose from the shattered city.
sentences.zh: 从那座破碎的城市中升起一丝庄重的烟雾。

senses.zh: 粉碎；打碎；破坏；破掉；使散开
